title: Define source-bound historical requirement traceability mapping
objective: Define a canonical read-only mapping contract that binds each historical requirement to its normative source, design references, implementation symbols, tests, contracts and evidence under one validated ENG-07.2 batch manifest, without executing historical audits or recording findings.
non_goals: populate mappings for real historical lots
record audit findings severity ownership or disposition
modify data/audit reports contracts or business code
integrate the new checks into CI in this WU

required_invariants: mapping is READ_ONLY and bound to one validated ENG-07.2 manifest identity
mapping lot belongs to the bound manifest batch and remains within historical Lots 0 through 44
mapping plan and batch identities equal the validated manifest identities
every requirement has a stable requirement_id and exact normative source reference
MAPPED requirements include at least one design reference implementation symbol test and evidence artifact
JUSTIFIED_NON_CODE requirements include an explicit formal justification plus design/evidence references and no fake implementation/test references
UNRESOLVED requirements remain explicit and cannot masquerade as complete coverage
repository references are relative traversal-free typed by category and duplicate-free
mapping identity is SHA-256 over canonical material excluding the identity field
validator is pure and performs no repository audit evidence or business/runtime mutation
acceptance_criteria: valid synthetic mapping validates and replays deterministically
tampering any identity-bound mapping field invalidates mapping identity
mapping a lot outside the bound manifest batch fails closed
Lot45 or later lot mapping fails closed
forged manifest plan or batch binding fails closed through ENG-07.2 validation
MAPPED requirement missing design implementation test contract/evidence coverage fails closed
JUSTIFIED_NON_CODE without justification or with fake implementation/test refs fails closed
UNRESOLVED status remains machine-visible and requires an explicit gap reason
absolute traversal malformed or duplicate repository references fail closed
no historical artifact or business/runtime state is mutated

done_when: mapping schema policy validator and adversarial tests are defined
traceability semantics distinguish complete justified-non-code and unresolved requirements without hiding gaps
all mappings remain bound to a validated read-only historical batch manifest
CI integration and executable qualification are deferred to ENG-07.3-WU02
